## (2) Per-sample tornado

To keep memory bounded for the 33-sample run, subsample each feature set
to at most 5,000 regions before normalizeToMatrix. The mean signal curve
is essentially indistinguishable from the full set, since each bin still
averages over thousands of regions.

```{r}
subsample_feats <- function(gr_list, max_n = 5000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  GRangesList(lapply(gr_list, function(g) {
    if (length(g) <= max_n) g
    else g[sort(sample.int(length(g), max_n))]
  }))
}
subsample_n <- 5000   # set to NULL to disable

feats_for_samples <- if (is.null(subsample_n)) {
  feats
} else {
  subsample_feats(feats, max_n = subsample_n)
}
vapply(feats_for_samples, length, integer(1))

df_samples_rds <- file.path(plot_dir, "df_samples_1k_w20.rds")
df_samples <- if (file.exists(df_samples_rds)) {
  message("Loading cached df_samples from ", df_samples_rds)
  readRDS(df_samples_rds)
} else {
  message("Computing df_samples (33 bigwig imports + normalizeToMatrix)...")
  out <- flatten_features_eh(feats_for_samples, bigwigs_samples,
                              extend = 1000, w = 20)
  saveRDS(out, df_samples_rds)
  out
}

p_samples <- tornado_facets(
  df_samples,
  "ATAC signal at region midpoints (selected samples, mean ± SEM)",
  ribbon       = "sem",
  ribbon_alpha = 0.15
) +
  theme(legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"))
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "tornado_per_sample_1k_w20.svg"),
       p_samples, width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# 8i. Per-region tornado heatmaps

±1000 bp / w = 20 bp matrices, same feature sets as 8h. Each row is a
region; columns are bin positions. Color = signal (raw) or fraction of
total per-(sample, bin) (sum-to-one normalization).

## Helpers

```{r}
compute_tornado_matrices <- function(features, bigwigs, extend = 1000, w = 20,
                                     verbose = TRUE) {
  ts  <- function() format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S")
  log <- function(...) if (verbose) message(sprintf("[%s] %s", ts(), paste0(...)))

  group_names <- names(features)
  combined <- do.call(c, lapply(group_names, function(fn) {
    g <- features[[fn]]
    if (length(g) == 0) return(g)
    mcols(g) <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(.group = rep(fn, length(g)))
    g
  }))
  group_factor <- factor(combined$.group, levels = group_names)
  target_mid   <- GenomicRanges::resize(combined, width = 1, fix = "center")
  log(sprintf(">> compute_tornado_matrices: %d sample(s) × %d feature group(s) → ",
              length(bigwigs), length(features)),
      sprintf("%s total regions, %d bins", format(length(target_mid), big.mark = ","),
              2 * extend / w))

  mats <- vector("list", length(bigwigs))
  names(mats) <- names(bigwigs)
  for (i in seq_along(bigwigs)) {
    sn <- names(bigwigs)[i]
    log(sprintf("  [%d/%d] %s: import + normalizeToMatrix ...",
                i, length(bigwigs), sn))
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    sig <- rtracklayer::import(bigwigs[[i]])
    mats[[sn]] <- EnrichedHeatmap::normalizeToMatrix(
      sig, target_mid,
      value_column = "score",
      extend = extend, mean_mode = "w0", w = w
    )
    log(sprintf("      done in %.1fs",
                as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs")))
    rm(sig); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }

  list(
    mats         = mats,
    group_factor = group_factor,
    extend       = extend,
    w            = w
  )
}

# Apply (or skip) sum_to_one across feature_sets, then compute one shared
# color function spanning every (sample, group, bin) cell. Lets multiple
# build_tornado_heatmap_independent() calls (e.g. diff vs nd splits)
# share an exact color scale.
compute_unified_col_fun <- function(tornado_data,
                                    normalize = c("none", "sum_to_one"),
                                    col_pal = c("white", "darkblue"),
                                    cap_quantile = 0.99) {
  normalize    <- match.arg(normalize)
  mats         <- tornado_data$mats
  group_factor <- tornado_data$group_factor

  if (normalize == "sum_to_one") {
    for (sn in names(mats)) {
      mat <- mats[[sn]]
      group_bin_means <- vapply(levels(group_factor), function(g) {
        colMeans(mat[group_factor == g, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      }, numeric(ncol(mat)))
      bin_totals <- rowSums(group_bin_means, na.rm = TRUE)
      mats[[sn]] <- sweep(mat, 2, pmax(bin_totals, 1e-12), "/")
    }
  }

  cap <- max(vapply(mats,
                    function(m) stats::quantile(m, cap_quantile, na.rm = TRUE),
                    numeric(1)))
  message(sprintf("compute_unified_col_fun: %d sample(s), %d group(s), cap = %.4f",
                  length(mats), length(levels(group_factor)), cap))
  circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, cap), col_pal)
}

# Per-sample INDEPENDENT row sorting: each sample's heatmap is built
# standalone with its own per-group row order, sorted by that sample's
# enriched_score. Returns a NAMED LIST of EnrichedHeatmap objects.
# Render the list with draw_independent_heatmaps() below.
build_tornado_heatmap_independent <- function(tornado_data,
                                              display_groups = NULL,
                                              normalize = c("none", "sum_to_one"),
                                              col_pal = c("white", "darkblue"),
                                              cap_quantile = 0.99,
                                              col_fun = NULL,
                                              use_raster = TRUE,
                                              group_colors = feature_group_colors,
                                              verbose = TRUE) {
  normalize    <- match.arg(normalize)
  mats         <- tornado_data$mats
  group_factor <- tornado_data$group_factor

  if (normalize == "sum_to_one") {
    for (sn in names(mats)) {
      mat <- mats[[sn]]
      group_bin_means <- vapply(levels(group_factor), function(g) {
        colMeans(mat[group_factor == g, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      }, numeric(ncol(mat)))
      bin_totals <- rowSums(group_bin_means, na.rm = TRUE)
      mats[[sn]] <- sweep(mat, 2, pmax(bin_totals, 1e-12), "/")
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(display_groups)) {
    keep_rows <- group_factor %in% display_groups
    mats <- lapply(mats, function(m) m[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE])
    group_factor <- factor(group_factor[keep_rows], levels = display_groups)
  }

  if (is.null(col_fun)) {
    cap <- max(vapply(mats,
                      function(m) stats::quantile(m, cap_quantile, na.rm = TRUE),
                      numeric(1)))
    col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, cap), col_pal)
  } else {
    cap <- environment(col_fun)$breaks[length(environment(col_fun)$breaks)]
  }
  legend_title <- if (normalize == "sum_to_one") "fraction" else "signal"

  line_cols <- group_colors[levels(group_factor)]
  if (any(is.na(line_cols))) {
    fallback <- scales::hue_pal()(length(levels(group_factor)))
    line_cols[is.na(line_cols)] <- fallback[is.na(line_cols)]
  }

  if (verbose) {
    message(sprintf("  independent sort: %d sample heatmap(s), %d feature groups, color cap = %.4f",
                    length(mats), length(levels(group_factor)), cap))
  }

  heatmaps <- lapply(seq_along(mats), function(i) {
    sn  <- names(mats)[i]
    mat <- mats[[sn]]

    new_order <- unlist(lapply(levels(group_factor), function(g) {
      gi <- which(group_factor == g)
      gi[order(EnrichedHeatmap::enriched_score(mat[gi, , drop = FALSE]),
               decreasing = TRUE)]
    }), use.names = FALSE)
    mat_sorted <- mat[new_order, , drop = FALSE]
    gf_sorted  <- group_factor[new_order]

    # Row-block titles only on the leftmost panel — keeps right panels compact.
    row_title <- if (i == 1L)
                   levels(group_factor)
                 else
                   rep("", length(levels(group_factor)))

    EnrichedHeatmap::EnrichedHeatmap(
      mat_sorted,
      col          = col_fun,
      name         = sn,
      column_title = sn,
      row_split    = gf_sorted,
      row_title    = row_title,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      use_raster   = use_raster,
      show_heatmap_legend  = (i == 1L),
      heatmap_legend_param = list(title = legend_title),
      top_annotation = ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
        enriched = EnrichedHeatmap::anno_enriched(
          gp = grid::gpar(col = line_cols, lty = 1, lwd = 1.2)
        )
      )
    )
  })
  names(heatmaps) <- names(mats)
  heatmaps
}

# Render a list of standalone heatmaps side-by-side in one SVG. Each
# heatmap is drawn in its own grid viewport, so per-sample row orders
# are preserved (no shared alignment from the `+` operator).
draw_independent_heatmaps <- function(heatmaps,
                                       svg_path,
                                       column_title = NULL,
                                       panel_width_in = 2.5,
                                       height_in = 10) {
  n <- length(heatmaps)
  total_width <- n * panel_width_in + 1.5   # reserve space for legend

  svg(svg_path, width = total_width, height = height_in)
  grid::grid.newpage()

  if (!is.null(column_title)) {
    grid::grid.text(column_title, x = 0.5, y = 0.97,
                    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))
    grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(y = 0.48, height = 0.92))
  }

  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(
    layout = grid::grid.layout(nrow = 1, ncol = n)
  ))

  for (i in seq_along(heatmaps)) {
    grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.col = i))
    ComplexHeatmap::draw(
      heatmaps[[i]],
      newpage = FALSE,
      show_heatmap_legend = (i == 1L),
      show_annotation_legend = (i == 1L)
    )
    grid::popViewport()
  }
  grid::popViewport()
  if (!is.null(column_title)) grid::popViewport()
  dev.off()
}
```

# 8j. GO enrichment weighted-rank plot — refined Renin vs Non-renin regions

Same GREAT enrichment + renin-term weighted-rank procedure as
`4_greatGOenrichment.Rmd` sections 4d/4e, but applied to the refined
region classification that combines both DESeq2 and StarSpace evidence:

- **Renin** = `inc_r` — regions that (1) showed increased accessibility
  in renin samples in the DESeq2 analysis AND (2) fell in the StarSpace
  Renin cluster from 8b.
- **Non-renin** = everything else in the StarSpace cluster universe,
  i.e. `inc_nr ∪ dec_r ∪ dec_nr ∪ nd_r ∪ nd_nr`. These are regions that
  failed at least one of the two criteria above.

Background: genome-wide null (no explicit `bg` arg to GREAT). Using the
cluster union as background here would push foreground ≈ background for
the Non-renin set (it covers ~99% of the universe), collapsing every
hypergeometric p-value toward 1 and emptying the post-filter table. The
genome-wide null lets both sets produce real enrichment tables that the
weighted-rank step can score against each other.

## Load packages

```{r}
library(rGREAT)
```

## Build refined Renin / Non-renin GRanges from 8e intersection BEDs

Reload from disk so this chunk is independent of whether the in-memory
`inc_r` / `dec_nr` / etc. variables have been overwritten by the
top-N or knee-based subsetting in 8g.

```{r}
load_bed_8j <- function(path) {
  readGeneric(path, chr = 1, start = 2, end = 3, strand = NULL,
              meta.cols = NULL, keep.all.metadata = FALSE,
              zero.based = FALSE, remove.unusual = FALSE,
              header = FALSE, skip = 0, sep = "\t")
}

inc_r_full  <- load_bed_8j(file.path(bed_dir, "inc_r.bed"))
inc_nr_full <- load_bed_8j(file.path(bed_dir, "inc_nr.bed"))
dec_r_full  <- load_bed_8j(file.path(bed_dir, "dec_r.bed"))
dec_nr_full <- load_bed_8j(file.path(bed_dir, "dec_nr.bed"))
nd_r_full   <- load_bed_8j(file.path(bed_dir, "nd_r.bed"))
nd_nr_full  <- load_bed_8j(file.path(bed_dir, "nd_nr.bed"))

renin_refined_gr <- inc_r_full
non_renin_gr     <- c(inc_nr_full, dec_r_full, dec_nr_full,
                      nd_r_full,  nd_nr_full)

message(sprintf(
  "Refined sets: Renin = %s regions (inc_r), Non-renin = %s regions (everything else)",
  format(length(renin_refined_gr), big.mark = ","),
  format(length(non_renin_gr),     big.mark = ",")
))

ss_query <- GenomicRanges::GRangesList(
  Renin     = renin_refined_gr,
  Non_renin = non_renin_gr
)
```

## Run GREAT GO Biological Process enrichment

```{r}
ss_getBioEnrichment <- function(gr) {
  # No explicit background: when the Non-renin set covers ~99% of the
  # cluster universe, foreground ≈ background and every hypergeometric
  # p-value collapses toward 1, leaving the filter step with zero rows.
  # Testing each set against the genome-wide null lets both produce real
  # enrichment tables that the weighted-rank step can compare.
  job <- rGREAT::submitGreatJob(gr, species = "mm10")
  tb  <- rGREAT::getEnrichmentTables(job)
  tb$`GO Biological Process`
}

ss_enrichment <- lapply(names(ss_query), function(s) {
  ss_getBioEnrichment(ss_query[[s]])
})
names(ss_enrichment) <- names(ss_query)
```

## Weighted rank of renin-related GO terms

```{r}
ss_filterEnrichment <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  # rGREAT 1.x column for foreground gene hits is `Hyper_Observed_Gene_Hits`,
  # not `Hyper_Foreground_Gene_Hits`. If your rGREAT version differs, the
  # message below shows the actual columns so you can swap names.
  message("Enrichment columns: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", "))
  keep <- df$Hyper_Adjp_BH <= 0.1 & df$Hyper_Observed_Gene_Hits >= 3
  go <- df[which(keep), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(go) <- seq_len(nrow(go))
  go
}

ss_getReninGOTerms <- function(dfs) {
  keywords <- c(
    "notch", "cAMP",
    "angiotensin", "aldosterone", "renin",
    "vasculogenesis", "blood vessel",
    "arteriole", "blood pressure",
    "smooth muscle cell",
    "cell fate",
    "kidney", "renal", "nephron"
  )
  pattern <- paste(keywords, collapse = "|")
  matched <- unlist(lapply(dfs, function(df) {
    df$name[grepl(pattern, df$name, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  }))
  unique(matched)
}

ss_getRank <- function(df, group) {
  df <- df[order(df$Hyper_Adjp_BH), ]
  df$rank_pvalue <- seq_len(nrow(df))
  df <- df[order(df$Hyper_Fold_Enrichment), ]
  df$rank_fold <- seq_len(nrow(df))
  df$Rank <- rowMeans(df[, c("rank_pvalue", "rank_fold")])
  df$Group <- group
  df
}

ss_getRankWeight <- function(dfs, my_go_terms) {
  total <- max(sapply(dfs, nrow))
  for (i in seq_along(dfs)) {
    dfs[[i]]$rank_pvalue_weight <- (total - dfs[[i]]$rank_fold) / total
    dfs[[i]] <- subset(dfs[[i]], name %in% my_go_terms)
  }
  for (t in my_go_terms) {
    term_sum <- sum(sapply(dfs, function(df) {
      w <- df$rank_pvalue_weight[df$name == t]
      if (length(w) == 0) 0 else w
    }))
    for (i in seq_along(dfs)) {
      idx <- dfs[[i]]$name == t
      if (any(idx)) {
        dfs[[i]]$rank_weight[idx] <- dfs[[i]]$rank_pvalue_weight[idx] / term_sum
      }
    }
  }
  dfs
}
```

```{r}
ss_go        <- lapply(ss_enrichment, ss_filterEnrichment)

# Guard: empty enrichment table after filtering usually means foreground ≈
# background (collapsing hypergeometric p-values toward 1). Print sizes so
# this is easy to diagnose if it happens.
n_rows_per_set <- sapply(ss_go, nrow)
message("Filtered enrichment table sizes: ",
        paste(sprintf("%s = %d", names(n_rows_per_set), n_rows_per_set),
              collapse = ", "))
if (any(n_rows_per_set == 0)) {
  stop("Empty enrichment table(s): ",
       paste(names(n_rows_per_set)[n_rows_per_set == 0], collapse = ", "),
       ". Check the foreground vs background sizes in ss_getBioEnrichment().")
}

ss_renin_terms <- ss_getReninGOTerms(ss_go)

ss_rank_dfs <- lapply(names(ss_go), function(s) ss_getRank(ss_go[[s]], group = s))
names(ss_rank_dfs) <- names(ss_go)
ss_rank_dfs <- ss_getRankWeight(ss_rank_dfs, ss_renin_terms)

ss_plot_df <- do.call(rbind, ss_rank_dfs)
ss_plot_df <- ss_plot_df[!is.na(ss_plot_df$name), ]
rownames(ss_plot_df) <- NULL

ss_plot_df <- ss_plot_df %>%
  select(name, Group,
         Rank_weight      = rank_weight,
         Pval_rank        = rank_pvalue,
         Pval_rank_weight = rank_pvalue_weight)

ss_plot_df$Group <- factor(ss_plot_df$Group, levels = c("Renin", "Non_renin"))

ss_term_order <- ss_plot_df %>%
  filter(Group == "Renin") %>%
  arrange(desc(Rank_weight)) %>%
  mutate(labels = factor(name)) %>%
  head(50)

ss_plot_df <- filter(ss_plot_df, name %in% ss_term_order$name)
ss_new_order <- ss_plot_df %>%
  filter(Group == "Renin") %>%
  arrange(desc(Rank_weight)) %>%
  mutate(labels = factor(name))
```

## Plot stacked bar of weighted rank

```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 7}
output_file <- file.path(plot_dir, "refined_renin_go_rank_weight_stacked_bar.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output_file), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

n_terms <- length(unique(ss_plot_df$name))

p_ss_go <- ss_plot_df %>%
  mutate(labels = factor(name, levels = ss_new_order$labels)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(fill = Group, y = Rank_weight, x = labels)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity", width = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Renin = "#e1812c", Non_renin = "lightgrey")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(y = "Enrichment Weight", x = "GO Terms",
       title = "Refined Renin (inc_r) vs Non-renin (everything else) — renin-related GO terms")

ggsave(output_file, plot = p_ss_go,
       width = max(4, n_terms * 0.1), height = 7, units = "in")

p_ss_go
```
